title: The Short Cash Box
summary: Baba Sola's POS kiosk keeps coming up short. Find every cash payout that never got paid for on the POS.

client.name: Baba Sola
brief: My son, this POS business wan kill me. People pay with card, I hand them cash, but every evening my cash is short.
I write every payout in my cash book. The POS keeps its own log. Can you find the payouts the POS never paid me for?
client.thanks: So it's the network failures! From today, no cash until the POS says 'success'. God bless you.

starterSql:
-- Baba Sola's POS kiosk: which cash payouts were never paid for?
-- cash_book: every cash payout he wrote down.  pos_log: what the POS terminal recorded.

SELECT *
FROM cash_book
LIMIT 20;

tables.name: cash_book
tables.description: Baba Sola's handwritten cash book, typed up: every cash payout he made.

columns.name: ref
columns.desc: POS reference he wrote down for the payout

columns.name: paid_at
columns.desc: When he handed over the cash

tables.name: pos_log
tables.description: Export from the POS terminal. Also includes airtime sales, which aren't cash-outs.

columns.name: status
columns.desc: success or failed (failed means no money arrived)

hints.title: Hint 1: What you're looking for
hints.desc: A payout is only paid for if the POS log has the same reference with status 'success'. Anything else is cash he lost.

hints.title: Hint 2: Compare the two lists
hints.desc: Find cash_book rows whose ref is not among the successful POS transactions.
hints.snippet: WHERE ref NOT IN (SELECT txn_id FROM pos_log WHERE status = 'success')

hints.title: Hint 3: Shape of the answer
hints.desc: Return one row per lost payout: its ref and amount.

findings.claim: How much cash did Baba Sola hand out without being paid?

options.text: ₦12,000: only the payouts missing from the POS log
₦31,700: the cash book total minus the POS total
₦32,500: missing payouts plus ones the POS marked failed
He pays out even when the POS fails or doesn't go through, so money never arrives.
Someone is taking money from the cash box at night.
The bank's POS charges are too high.

successFeedback: Every lost payout either failed on the POS or was never processed. Baba Sola was handing out cash on trust. No thief, just the network.

fixtures.purpose: The two days you can see
fixtures.failHint: Your list of unpaid payouts doesn’t match the records.

fixtures.purpose: A day with many failed POS transactions
fixtures.failHint: A payout whose POS transaction failed was never paid for. Check status.
Some payouts don’t appear in the POS log at all; they still count as unpaid.

fixtures.purpose: A day where every payout was paid
fixtures.failHint: On a clean day your query should return no payouts.

evidence.title: A crumpled POS slip
evidence.text: Found by the kiosk counter. POS-5766 · ₦17,500 · 12/11 16:32 · TRANSACTION DECLINED: NETWORK TIMEOUT. On the back, in Baba Sola's handwriting: "Ibrahim. Paid cash, will settle later." A second slip underneath: POS-5778 · ₦3,000 · 13/11 · DECLINED.
